title: Bare Infinitive
theory:
 A Bare Infinitive is a base form of a Verb. It is a non-finite verb. It does not show tense,
 person, or number.
Bare Infinitive Verb dk og base form (V1) gksrk is whose first "to" ugha yxk;k tkrkA bls non-finite

Verb also dgrs are because;g tense, person and number ugha crkrkA
 Where to use Bare Infinitive:
 1 Modal + VBase
 2 See/ Notice/ Feel/ Hear/ Smell/ Watch/ Help + VBase
 3 Had better/ Had rather/ Would better/ Would rather + VBase
 Note: Sub + would + Sub + Past indefinite (V2)
 4 Do nothing but + VBase
 5 Cannot but + VBase
 6 Why + VBase (Suggestion/Complain)
 7 Make/ Let/ Bid/ Have + VBase
 8 Can't help but + VBase
